title: NFP Quiz: What Does Smart Money Do BEFORE The Numbers Drop? 🧠

script: NFP drops tomorrow. Quick quiz — what does smart money do RIGHT BEFORE the release? Most traders get this wrong. Before NFP, smart money does one of three things. A) Buys the breakout.
